# Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions

> Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions is a local tour operator in Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic. We pick up cruise passengers at Amber Cove and Taíno Bay, plan the day around the ship’s schedule and look after you in English and Spanish.

- Website: https://popcruiseexcursions.com/
- WhatsApp: +1 (829) 627-7733 (https://wa.me/18296277733)
- Email: popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com
- Location: Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic
- Payment: PayPal, Zelle, Cash App

## Tours

Prices in US dollars. Per-person prices depend on the size of the group.

- [Damajagua Waterfalls](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-damajagua): Jump, swim and slide at the 27 Charcos de Damajagua, the most famous natural waterfalls on the north coast. Add the zipline and fly over the jungle. From US$50.
  - 1 to 2 people: US$120 with zipline, US$100 no zipline
  - 3 to 5 people: US$100 with zipline, US$75 no zipline
  - 6 to 14 people: US$80 with zipline, US$65 no zipline
  - 15 to 50 people: US$70 with zipline, US$50 no zipline
  - 50% of the total to book
- [Puerto Plata City Tour](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-city): See the best of the city with a guide, then wrap up with free time at Playa Dorada. From US$12.
  - 1 to 2 people: US$30 per person
  - 3 to 5 people: US$20 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$15 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$12 per person
  - 50% of the total to book
- [Horseback riding](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-horse): An hour and a half on horseback along the beach and through the Puerto Plata countryside, riding right into the sea. From US$60.
  - 1 to 2 people: US$85 per person
  - 3 to 5 people: US$70 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$65 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$60 per person
  - 50% of the total to book
- [Buggies & ATVs](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-buggy): Two hours on an ATV or buggy along dirt roads, mud and countryside, with a stop at the beach and another at a traditional Dominican house where you taste coffee, chocolate and cigars. From US$75 per vehicle.
  - Single ATV (1 person): US$90 per vehicle for 1 to 2 vehicles, US$75 per vehicle for 3 or more vehicles
  - Double ATV (2 people): US$100 per vehicle for 1 to 2 vehicles, US$85 per vehicle for 3 or more vehicles
  - Buggy (2 people): US$120 per vehicle for 1 to 2 vehicles, US$100 per vehicle for 3 or more vehicles
  - Family buggy (4 people): US$160 per vehicle for 1 to 2 vehicles, US$140 per vehicle for 3 or more vehicles
  - 50% of the total to book
- [Playa Dorada Beach Day](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/#tour-beach): A worry-free day at the beach: we take you straight to Playa Dorada, with umbrellas and loungers reserved for your group, and bring you back to the port with plenty of time to spare. From US$15.
  - 1 to 2 people: US$50 per person
  - 3 to 5 people: US$30 per person
  - 6 to 14 people: US$25 per person
  - 15 to 50 people: US$15 per person
  - 50% of the total to book
- [Private catamaran or yacht](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/puerto-plata-catamaran/): Charter the whole boat just for your group and sail the Puerto Plata coast. Choose from 4 catamarans and 2 yachts. From US$900 per boat.
  - Viking 48': US$900 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$30 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Yacht with jacuzzi: US$950 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$40 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Fountaine Pajot 43': US$1,100 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$25 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - The Ocean King IV: US$1,000 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$45 per extra person; US$400 deposit to book
  - Libreterre · Privilege 52': US$1,250 for the whole boat (up to 20 people), +US$25 per extra person; US$550 deposit to book
  - Catamaran with jacuzzi: US$1,300 for the whole boat (up to 15 people), +US$30 per extra person; US$700 deposit to book
  - Optional round-trip transport port ↔ Sosúa, 1 to 8 people: US$160 for the group
  - Optional round-trip transport port ↔ Sosúa, 9 to 15 people: US$195 for the group
  - Optional round-trip transport port ↔ Sosúa, 16 to 20 people: US$300 for the group
  - Optional round-trip transport port ↔ Sosúa, 21 to 28 people: US$375 for the group
  - Optional round-trip transport port ↔ Sosúa, 29 to 45 people: US$595 for the group

## Booking and policies

- [Privacy policy](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/privacy/)
- [Booking terms](https://popcruiseexcursions.com/booking-terms/)

### Where do the tours start?

We pick you up at the Puerto Plata cruise port and bring you back when the tour ends. Round-trip transport is included in every other tour; for catamarans and yachts it’s optional: they leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay, and you can add the transport when you book, priced by group size.

### Do you pick up at Amber Cove and Taíno Bay?

Yes. We pick you up at whichever port your ship docks at, Amber Cove or Taíno Bay, and bring you back when the tour ends. We confirm the exact meeting point on WhatsApp or by email when you book. For catamarans and yachts, transport to Sosúa is optional and priced by group size.

### Which port will my cruise ship dock at?

Your cruise itinerary says so. In general, Amber Cove receives Carnival Corporation ships (Carnival, Princess, Holland America…) and Taíno Bay receives Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Norwegian, MSC and other lines. Tell us your ship’s name when you book and we’ll check.

### Will I make it back to my ship on time?

We plan every tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

### How do group prices work?

The price per person depends on how many of you travel together: 1 to 2, 3 to 5, 6 to 14 or 15 to 50 people. The bigger the group, the less each person pays. Buggies and ATVs are priced per vehicle, and cost less from 3 vehicles on. Catamarans and yachts work differently: you charter the whole boat for a flat price for up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person costs extra.

### What’s included in the Damajagua Waterfalls tour?

Round-trip transport, water along the way and a buffet lunch at the waterfalls’ restaurant. The zipline is optional.

### Is lunch included in the City Tour?

No. At the end of the tour you get free time at Playa Dorada, where you can have lunch at one of the beachfront restaurants if you like. Lunch and extra drinks are not included.

### What language are the tours in?

English and Spanish. Message us on WhatsApp or by email in whichever language you prefer.

### What should I bring on the tour?

A swimsuit, a towel and sunscreen; shoes that can get wet if you’re going to Damajagua; some cash in US dollars for tips and shopping; and your cruise card plus a photo ID to get back on board.

### What is your cancellation policy?

Cancel 10 or more days before your tour and we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days’ notice, we refund 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%.

### How do I pay?

You book with a deposit via PayPal, Zelle or Cash App: 50% of the total for the tours, and a fixed amount for catamarans and yachts (shown in each boat’s details). You pay the rest in person on the day of the tour. For the tours, you can also pay the full price in advance.

### Which cruise lines dock at Amber Cove?

Mostly Carnival Corporation brands: Carnival, Princess, Holland America, P&O and other lines in the group. Other cruise lines call occasionally, so check your cruise itinerary. If your ship docks at Taíno Bay instead, we pick you up there too.

### How far is Amber Cove from downtown Puerto Plata?

About 12 km (7.5 miles), a 15–20 minute drive. It is not walkable: the port sits on Maimón Bay, west of the city. Round-trip transport from the port is included in our other tours; for the catamarans and yachts it’s optional.

### How far are the Damajagua waterfalls from Amber Cove?

About 30–45 minutes by road, depending on traffic. The 27 Charcos de Damajagua (Damajagua Falls) are near Imbert, south of Puerto Plata. We pick you up at the port and bring you back, and the tour includes a buffet lunch.

### Can I book a tour that my cruise line doesn’t sell?

Yes. You can leave the port during your call and take your tour with a local operator like us. Tell us your ship’s name and all-aboard time: we pick you up at the port and plan the day around your ship’s schedule.

### What is there inside Amber Cove?

Pools, shops, restaurants, bars and a zip line; some attractions cost extra. To see more of Puerto Plata, our tours start right at the port: waterfalls, the city, the beach or a private boat.

### Which cruise lines dock at Taíno Bay?

Lines such as Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Norwegian and MSC, among others. It can vary by sailing, so check your cruise itinerary. If your ship docks at Amber Cove instead, we pick you up there too.

### Can you walk from Taíno Bay to downtown Puerto Plata?

Yes. The historic center is about a 10–15 minute walk: Umbrella Street, the Amber Museum and Central Park. The San Felipe Fortress is visible from the port. It gets hot, so bring water. Our City Tour covers downtown with a guide and ends at Playa Dorada.

### How far is Playa Dorada from Taíno Bay?

About 10–15 minutes by car, east of the city. Our Beach Day includes private round-trip transport, umbrellas reserved for your group, a lounger for everyone and 4 hours at the beach.

### How far are the Damajagua waterfalls from Taíno Bay?

About 35–45 minutes by road, depending on traffic. We pick you up at the port, take you to the 27 Charcos de Damajagua near Imbert and bring you back. The tour includes a buffet lunch.

### What is there inside Taíno Bay?

A pool with a bar, loungers and shops. Because the port is right in the city, you can also head out on foot or take a tour: waterfalls, the city, the beach or a private boat, with pickup at the port.

### Is the price per person or for the boat?

For the whole boat. Unlike shared boat trips, which are sold per person, you charter the boat just for your group for 4 hours. The price covers up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person pays extra. Each boat’s price is in its details.

### Where do the boats leave from? Is transport included?

From Sosúa beach, about 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay. Round-trip transport from the port is optional: add it in the booking form; it’s priced by group size (see the table with the boats).

### How do I book a boat?

Choose the boat, fill in the booking form and send it to us on WhatsApp or by email: we write it up for you, ready to send. You book with a deposit; each boat’s amount is in its details. Tell us your ship’s name and all-aboard time.

### Are the boats good for bachelorette parties, birthdays or weddings?

Yes. Since the boat is just for your group, it’s a great way to celebrate: bachelorette parties, birthdays, small weddings or a family day. On the Libreterre we can help with decorations, cake, catering, photos and video (on request).
